title: Law No. (7) of 2022 regarding Environment
citation: Law No. (7) of 2022 (issued 2022-03-15), Official Gazette No. 3593 of 2022-03-17; replaces Legislative Decree No. (21) of 1996
evidence: Art. (125) of the Arabic text: "على رئيس مجلس الوزراء والوزراء - كُلٌّ فيما يخصه - تنفيذ أحكام هذا القانون، ويُعمل به بعد مُضِيِّ ستة أشهر من تاريخ نشْرِه في الجريدة الرسمية." (in force after six months from publication in the Official Gazette). Published in Official Gazette No. 3593 of 17-March-2022 (LLOC listing, opened 2026-11-03 through POST https://www.lloc.gov.bh/en/legislation/search: "Date : 17-March-2022", "Official Gazette No. : 3593"). Text opened at https://www.lloc.gov.bh/Legislation/HTM/K0722 on 2026-11-03. Computed date: the six months run from the Gazette date and the Law applies from the day after they end; no official page states the date itself.
notes: Umbrella environmental law. It contains no climate-change, greenhouse gas or reporting duty of the ESG disclosure kind (the Arabic text has no use of "المناخ"); it covers air, water, waste, marine and soil protection and environmental permits. It replaces Legislative Decree No. (21) of 1996 (LLOC lists that decree and its 1997 amendment; they are not in scope because the Law of 2022 replaces them). Art. (123) says the Prime Minister issues the executive regulation; no executive regulation was found on lloc.gov.bh (13 hits for "environment" on 2026-11-03, none of them an executive regulation of this Law). Date: the Law says it applies "after six months from the date of its publication"; the in_force date is the day after the six months run from the Gazette date (2022-03-17), computed, because no official page states the date itself. Languages: ar stored. English: LLOC serves an English version (https://www.lloc.gov.bh/FullEn/K0722.docx, "Published on the website on May 2024", disclaimer: for guidance and easy reference, the official version is the Arabic one in the Official Gazette); the row BH-LLOC-TRANSLATION is permission requested, so it is not stored. LLOC lists no amendment.

title: Law No. (54) of 2014 Approving the Unified Law (Regulation) regarding Ozone-Depleting Substances for the Gulf Cooperation Council Countries
citation: Law No. (54) of 2014, Official Gazette No. 3177 of 2014-10-02
evidence: Art. 7 of the Arabic text: "على رئيس مجلس الوزراء والوزراء -كل فيما يخصه- تنفيذ هذا القانون، ويعُمل به من اليوم التالي لتاريخ نشره في الجريدة الرسمية." (in force from the day after publication in the Official Gazette). Published in Official Gazette No. 3177 of 2-October-2014 (LLOC listing, opened 2026-11-03 through POST https://www.lloc.gov.bh/en/legislation/search: "Date : 2-October-2014", "Official Gazette No. : 3177"). Text opened at https://www.lloc.gov.bh/Legislation/HTM/K5414 on 2026-11-03. Computed date: the Gazette date plus one day; no official page states the date itself.
notes: Approves the GCC Unified Regulation on Ozone-Depleting Substances; the Arabic record holds the approving Law and the attached Unified Regulation as LLOC serves them (the Regulation says it applies 90 days after adoption by the GCC Supreme Council; that adoption date is not stated on the page, so the date here is that of the approving Law). Related older instrument not in scope: Decision No. (1) of 1999 on the Control of Substances Depleting the Ozone Layer (RHME0199), whose current status was not checked. English version exists on LLOC (K5414.docx, guidance translation); BH-LLOC-TRANSLATION is permission requested, so it is not stored. LLOC lists no amendment.

title: Decision No. (1) of 2015 regarding the Standards and Requirements of the System of Quotas for Companies and the Method of Distributing the Kingdom of Bahrain's Share of HCFC Substances
citation: Decision of the Chairman of the Supreme Council for Environment No. (1) of 2015, Official Gazette No. 3227 of 2015-09-17
evidence: Art. (13) of the Arabic text: "على الرئيس التنفيذي للمجلس الأعلى للبيئة تنفيذ هذا القرار، ويُعمل به اعتباراً من اليوم التالي لتاريخ نشره في الجريدة الرسمية." (in force from the day after publication in the Official Gazette). Published in Official Gazette No. 3227 of 17-September-2015 (LLOC listing, opened 2026-11-03 through POST https://www.lloc.gov.bh/en/legislation/search: "Date : 17-September-2015", "Official Gazette No. : 3227"). Text opened at https://www.lloc.gov.bh/Legislation/HTM/RSCE0115 on 2026-11-03. Computed date: the Gazette date plus one day; no official page states the date itself.
notes: Quota system for hydrochlorofluorocarbons (ozone-depleting substances, Montreal Protocol phase-out), issued under Legislative Decree No. (47) of 2012. The Environment Law of 2022 (bh-env-law-7-2022) replaced the earlier framework; lloc.gov.bh lists this Decision without a repeal note, and no page opened says whether it survives. English version exists on LLOC (RSCE0115.docx, guidance translation); BH-LLOC-TRANSLATION is permission requested, so it is not stored. LLOC lists no amendment.

title: Decision No. (7) of 2025 establishing and forming the committee for implementing the National Investment Plan for Adaptation to Climate Change (title translated from the Arabic)
citation: Decision of the Chairman of the Supreme Council for Environment No. (7) of 2025 (issued 2025-11-10), Official Gazette No. 3848 of 2025-12-04
evidence: Art. (11) of the Arabic text: "على المعنيين – كُلٌّ فيما يخصه – تنفيذ أحكام هذا القرار، ويُعمل به من اليوم التالي لتاريخ نشره في الجريدة الرسمية." (in force from the day after publication in the Official Gazette). Published in Official Gazette No. 3848 of 4-December-2025 (LLOC listing, opened 2026-11-03 through POST https://www.lloc.gov.bh/en/legislation/search: "Date : 4-December-2025", "Official Gazette No. : 3848"). Text opened at https://www.lloc.gov.bh/Legislation/HTM/RSCE0725 on 2026-11-03. Computed date: the Gazette date plus one day; no official page states the date itself.
notes: An institutional decision (a committee that reports every three months to the Ministerial Committee for Development Projects and Infrastructure on the national climate adaptation investment plan); it sets no duty on companies. English: LLOC serves no English version of this Decision (looked for in the LLOC search with English filter and at /FullEn/RSCE0725.docx, HTTP 404 on 2026-11-03). No amendment listed.

title: Law No. (35) of 2012 with respect to Consumer Protection
citation: Law No. (35) of 2012 (issued 2012-07-12), Official Gazette No. 3063 of 2012-08-02
evidence: Art. (25) of the Arabic text: "على رئيس مجلس الوزراء والوزراء – كل فيما يخصه – تنفيذ هذا القانون، وُيعمل به من اليوم التالي لتاريخ نشره في الجريدة الرسمية." (in force from the day after publication in the Official Gazette). Published in Official Gazette No. 3063 of 2-August-2012 (LLOC listing, opened 2026-11-03 through POST https://www.lloc.gov.bh/en/legislation/search: "Date : 2-August-2012", "Official Gazette No. : 3063"). Text opened at https://www.lloc.gov.bh/Legislation/HTM/K3512 on 2026-11-03. Computed date: the Gazette date plus one day; no official page states the date itself.
notes: Umbrella for environmental claims: Art. (6) requires every supplier or advertiser to give the consumer correct information on the nature and characteristics of the product and to avoid creating an untrue or misleading impression. The Law has no environmental or green-claim clause. The record is the Law as published in the Gazette (adopted form). LLOC lists one amendment, Law No. (28) of 2026 (bh-consumer-protection-law-28-2026, in scope, which replaces the definition of the competent administrative authority and Arts. (22) para. 1 and (23)); LLOC also serves an Arabic "with amendments" Word file (/FullAr/K3512.docx) that states no amendment date, so it is not stored as a dated version. Languages: ar stored; English exists on LLOC (K3512.docx, guidance translation); BH-LLOC-TRANSLATION is permission requested, so it is not stored.

title: Bahrain Bourse Listing Rules (version 5.0, 2024) and Guidelines on Listing Rules, with the ESG reporting requirements
citation: Bahrain Bourse Listing Rules, version 5.0 (Board of Directors resolution 3/5/2024, meeting 5/2024 of 30/09/2024), published 2024-11-13 under CBB Resolution No. (11) of 2018 (Self-Regulatory Organization)
evidence: Bahrain Bourse news item dated Wednesday, November 13, 2024 (https://bahrainbourse.com/en/News%20and%20Events/BHBNews/in-alignment-with-cbb%E2%80%99s-esg-requirements?month=11&year=2024, opened 2026-11-03): "The Listing Rules and Guidelines will be effective immediately." The Listing Rules PDF (https://bahrainbourse.com/en/Rules%20and%20Regulations/LegalFramework/Documents/ListingRules_2024.pdf) answers Last-Modified: Wed, 13 Nov 2024 08:44:28 GMT.
notes: Section on ESG Reporting, paragraphs 5.21 and 5.22 of the Listing Rules PDF (read with pdftotext on 2026-11-03): "The Issuers shall establish and maintain its own framework for ESG reporting in accordance with the relevant BHB and CBB ESG reporting guidelines." and "The Issuer shall submit its ESG report no later than 6 months after the end of its Financial Year." The news item says the ESG requirements are those of the CBB Common Volume ESG module (bh-cbb-esg-module) and apply to reporting periods ending December 2024. The existing register row pointed at the news item; the row now points at the Legal Framework page that lists the Listing Rules PDF (the news item is kept in the register row notes). Bahrain Bourse is a company and its terms say the website and services are its intellectual property: BH-BHB-ADOPTED is permission requested, so no text is stored. The 'Guidelines on Listing Rules' were not found as a separate file on the Legal Framework page.
status_note: Row BH-BHB-ADOPTED is permission requested; permission not requested.

title: Central Bank of Bahrain Rulebook, Common Volume, Module ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance Requirements), January 2024
citation: CBB Rulebook Common Volume, Module ESG, first issued November 2023, January 2024 version; issued under Arts. 38 and 65(b) of the Central Bank of Bahrain and Financial Institutions Law 2006
evidence: No official page opened states a commencement date. Module ESG-A.2.1 (https://cbben.thomsonreuters.com/sites/default/files/net_file_store/Common_Vol_ESG_January_2024.pdf, opened 2026-11-03): "This Module was first issued in November 2023." The Bahrain Bourse news item of 2024-11-13 says the Module applies to the reporting period ending December 2024.
notes: Scope (ESG-A.1.7): listed companies, banks, insurance firms, Category 1 and Category 2 investment firms, financing companies. The module sets ESG KPIs (Appendix 1) and a reporting process (ESG-1). The brief said first reporting year FY2024; the module text read has no such sentence, only the Bourse news item gives the December 2024 reporting period. The Rulebook host answered 403 to a plain curl and 200 to a desktop Chrome user agent. Row BH-CBB-ADOPTED is permission requested (CBB copyright page), so no text is stored.
status_note: Row BH-CBB-ADOPTED is permission requested; no commencement date stated on the page; permission not requested.
